article.title: 騰訊推出獨立元寶搜尋，涵蓋網頁及微信內容
article.summary: 騰訊公布元寶搜尋上線，搜尋範圍包括公開網頁、微信公眾號及短片內容，以及學術文獻。
highlights: 可從瀏覽器進入搜尋網站。
最新版QQ瀏覽器可在引擎設定切換至元寶搜尋。
article.why: 中國市場團隊可抽查品牌問題在不同內容平台的答案和引用來源。
article.next_step: 用品牌及品類各五條問題，記錄引用網址和商品資訊，交予資料負責人核對。
article.detail: 騰訊稱，元寶搜尋以元寶模型支援搜尋流程，可在瀏覽器直接使用，亦可設為最新版QQ瀏覽器的搜尋引擎。公告列出的來源包括網頁、微信公眾號、視頻號和學術文獻。品牌可抽查產品與售後問題的來源，按原頁核對價格、規格及服務條款。若原頁資料已更新，可再比較兩次搜尋結果。
article.title_en: Tencent launches standalone Yuanbao Search across the web and WeChat content
article.summary_en: Tencent launched Yuanbao Search, with stated coverage including web pages, WeChat Official Accounts, Channels and academic literature.
highlights_en: The search website is accessible from a browser.
The latest QQ Browser lets users switch to Yuanbao Search in search-engine settings.
article.why_en: China marketing teams can sample brand questions and check answers and citations across content platforms.
article.next_step_en: Use five brand and five category questions, then send the cited URLs and product details to their owners for review.
article.detail_en: Tencent says Yuanbao Search uses its Yuanbao model across the search workflow. It is available from a browser and can be set as the engine in the latest QQ Browser. Listed sources include web pages, WeChat Official Accounts, Channels and academic literature. Check product and service citations for current prices, specifications and terms. If a source page changes, compare results before and after the update.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
